description: This file is the main entry point for a Flutter-based notes application. It initializes environment variables, sets up the Supabase client, and defines the main widget structure, including themes, navigation, and screens for listing, viewing, creating, editing, and deleting notes. The code manages the UI and interactions with a backend database through Supabase.

classes.name: NotesApp
classes.description: Main stateless widget that sets up the MaterialApp and themes, serving as the application root.

classes.name: NotesHomePage
classes.description: Stateful widget managing the home screen with navigation, drawer, notes list, and FAB.

classes.name: NotesListScreen
classes.description: Stateful widget that fetches and displays a list of notes from Supabase.

classes.name: NoteDetailScreen
classes.description: Displays detailed view of a single note, with options to edit or delete.

classes.name: NoteEditScreen
classes.description: Screen for creating or editing a note, with form validation and save/delete functionality.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point; initializes environment and runs the app.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for the corresponding widget.

methods.name: _deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note from the database.

methods.name: _loadNote
methods.description: Fetches a single note's data from the database by ID.

methods.name: _saveNote
methods.description: Handles creating or updating a note in the database.
